implementation.assets: Existing local model/data/C0/native context first. No model download/C0 recomputation or large artifact transfer. Git canon/source metadata transfer authorized; report exact missing inputs.

planner: Unchanged v12 native sentences/teacher/readout/loss, current||entry KL .0625; delta=a_l*u_l, norm(.5/a_star)sum||u_l||, shared relative budget .75; independent request EfficiencyAdam lr .1/a_star eps=a_star*1e-8, all-layer RMSgamma, projection FP64 then FP32. Request Jr<.05 beforebackward/25eval24update max; terminal last evaluated canonical post-injection z, no terminal extra backward/forward. No ref/replay/pulse/warmup/newcost/topk.

writers.common: Same terminal D/u/z/anchors in every branch; exact RAM W0/H0/RNG/context/cache/ledger restore and verification between branches. Branch own actual lower writes precede every upper K/h capture. Five endpoint branches are not 500 unique edits. No cross-branch causal key reuse.
writers.RT: native mean-key ridge tracking T=z_virtual-h_actual; metric C0/H binding per canon
writers.MT: minimum-energy equality/range LS on native mean keys, tracking T=z_virtual-h_actual
writers.MD: same mean equality/range LS, direct T=D
writers.CD: all native injected subject keys, rewrite AND KL, repeated owner D for every row including KL; equal owner mass1/B and row1/(B*q_r), adapter-derived q_r/dimensions/native roles, no hardcoded universal6+1
writers.metric: A=sym(15000*C0+H_entry) FP64; record skew, require SPD without jitter. Cholesky-whiten X=L^-1 K sqrt(w), Z=T sqrt(w), direct SVD/QR-SVD, U=Z X+ L^-1 via triangular solve. Cutoff eps64*max(X.shape)*sigma_max, retained strict>, no normal-equation rank or threshold retune.
writers.range_policy: Rank deficiency/incompatible target is valid recorded RANGE_PROJECTED_LS when numerical projected-target solve verified. Never label infeasible-target residual numerical error or silently use ridge fallback/shrink/pinv of original Gram/jitter.
writers.zero_policy: Keep zero/repeated target columns. Solve skip only when whole actual branch target T is zero: D==0 is NOT sufficient for tracking RT/MT if inherited tracking residual is nonzero. History still appends.
writers.application: FP32 native orientation Wnew=Wold+cast32(U). Distinguish ideal U, cast U, Ueff=double(Wnew)-double(Wold), actual local hidden effects. Capture keys/hidden without subject injection during physical write.
writers.history: Each successful branch endpoint allfive writes then final native rewrite-only nested-mean K capture, CPUFP32 H+=Kfinal Kfinal.T exactly once/layer. No KL/history Gram, success filtering, dedup, or additional sequential commits. Restore afterward.

qualification.CPU: Original reference16 plus production regression tests for branch target/mapping/range/numerical errors/zero columns/history/rollback/horizon/noCP and independent metric reducer.
qualification.actual: B1 native inputs only; small operator, actual-key, cast/local-additivity and exact RAM restore checks without extra fit/BS2 chain. Reuse same fit intermediate state for checks where valid. Seal source/config/budget/tolerances before submit.
qualification.numerical_projection: ||U K sqrt(w)-Zhat|| <= 1e-10 +1e-8||Z|| where Zhat=Z Vret Vret.T. Full target mismatch separately reports range infeasibility.
qualification.FP32: Elementwise ideal U K vs Ueff K and actual local-additivity vs Ueff K atol2e-5/rtol2e-4 as canon; norm ratios alone are not parity. Record every error/tolerance/row identity.
qualification.block: Input/shape/native semantic/nonfinite/SPD/numerical projection/cast-local parity/restore errors stop invalid commit. No silent numeric-method/tolerance change; minimal causal implementation repair/new sealed attempt and requalification, no repeating to pass.
qualification.not_gate: ACC/PS/NS, concentration, weak or negative realization, inherited gap, zero planned edit, budgetstop or range-incompatible LS itself are observations, not scientific promotion gates.
qualification.provenance: Owner audit + preflight red checklist required; independent reviewer only if actually used. CPU toy passes are not actual model proof.

evaluation.cost: Fit once; per branch capture/factor/SVD/solve/apply/history/eval/accounting/VRAM/RSS, parent allocations once. No aggregate5branch denominator as500 unique requests or extrapolated2k claim.
evaluation.historical: Read-only existing AlphaEdit/ridge/etc only matched identities and same cohort/endpoint; otherwise HISTORICAL_REFERENCE or NOT_AVAILABLE, no additional baseline fit/evaluation.
